name: 40 Mock reset (one call resets every mock, core ledger back to its seed)
description: Ticket 103, FRS MCT-07, MCK-08, MCT-08: POST /test/mock-control/reset (test-only APISIX route to mw-simulators) resets every mock party of mw-simulators and fans out to mw-core-mock, whose ledger goes back to its seed files (seed/v1/); the core is a party of the same mock-control engine and the old fault API is its alias. Nothing else in the stack is reset.
